posts.name: MightySi
posts.cooked:
I tend to play Venegance games on the floor because of the space needed.  I line up villains and heroes alternately below each other with the enviroment at the bottom.

This helps me keep track of whos turn is next and makes for logical play.

Also, I play solo a lot so if you play in a group this might not be the best way to do things.
